source: Mota et al. (2013), DOI 10.1007/s00466-013-0876-1; user-supplied LieGroupLieAlg.pdf
scope: Tables 2-3, Sections 6.1, 6.2, 6.2.1 and 6.2.2. Section 6.3 excluded by user; no Albany.

assumptions: L=1 fixes the unspecified length scale; absolute volume L2 errors scale as L^(3/2).
The rectangular reference beam is centered at the origin.
Directional counts for the 16- and 2500-element meshes are not supplied. The aspect ratio 4 and one Z element from Section 6.2.1 are extended to these meshes.
Convergence meshes are (4*k,k,1), with k doubled. The paper does not specify a complete refinement list.
Rotation uses the continuous analytic angle X/R in Eq. 6.7, including endpoints at +/-pi; no principal-log re-encoding occurs.
No-polar matrix-log interpolation uses SciPy's complex principal log; its imaginary part is preserved. The paper does not give its logarithm implementation/branch choices.
Recovery methods follow the descriptions literally, with an unweighted average across incident elements for methods 1 and 2.

exact_reproduction_policy: Numerical algorithm checks and agreement with published values are separate. Report every mismatch; do not calibrate unspecified meshes or scales to the printed results.
